# Changelog

- Added the UtterPlan-driven synthesis pipeline for local and managed Pocket ONNX bundles
- Added convenience APIs for managed synthesis and atomic WAV file output
- Added managed asset progress reporting, runtime checks, and documented first-WAV workflows
- Added managed and local quickstart scripts and expanded CLI synthesis controls
